name: Motegi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Motegi town emblem in white: a ring open at the hoist enclosing a stylised mountain of two peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Motegi, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 1969.

features.role: Motegi town emblem — a ring open at the hoist enclosing a stylised mountain of two peaks
